podcast.title: Album Artwork Exhibitions
podcast.body: ECM, a German indie label, held album artwork exhibitions in art galleries across Europe, demonstrating their serious approach to the art form. "There's a German indie label called ECM that took album artwork so seriously that they had exhibitions and art galleries all across Europe."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
